findings.field: Item 1 — Date of transaction or of listing (MM/DD/YYYY)
findings.now: The Item 1 date opens filled with today's date (or 31 December for an earlier tax year), and the user can file with that date unchanged.
findings.why: new_draft takes _period and sets month and day from the clock (views/form_2552_view.rs:1120-1129), so the library tile's period does not set the transaction date.

options.name: Blank the date
options.detail: Leave MM and DD empty so the official required-field alerts ('Month field on Page 1 Item 1 is required.') drive entry.

options.name: Flag as default
options.detail: Keep today's date but mark it as a default that must be confirmed before queueing.

findings.now: The Needs review section shows at most 20 messages, with parse errors listed before validation errors, so later alerts are hidden and the order does not follow the official rule order.
findings.why: The list is capped with take(20) over the chained parse and validation errors, which does not follow the source order in rules/forms/2552-v2018/validations.json.

options.name: Lift the cap
options.detail: Show every message and state the total above the list.

options.name: Sort by rule order
options.detail: Order the messages by the official rule order before display.

findings.now: Remove deletes a Part IV, Part V or Part VI row and its amounts at once, with no confirmation or undo.
findings.why: The row's Remove button calls edit() to delete the row directly (views/form_2552_view.rs:810-822), and a Part V list can hold up to 100 entries.

options.name: Confirm when filled
options.detail: Ask 'Remove row N?' only when the row has an amount typed.

options.name: Undo notice
options.detail: Show an undo notice for a few seconds after each removal.
